build_kimi_causal_lm: build a KimiLinear causal language model with config, quantization config, and parallel LM head
create_moe_expert_routing: create a Mixture-of-Experts layer with gate, top-k routing, shared experts, and tensor parallel all-reduce

build_decoder_layer: build a KimiDecoderLayer with conditional KDA or MLA attention and MoE or MLP feedforward network
